difficulty_reason: Localizes A at elements outside p step by step using the fibre-product patch A' = A'' x_{A_f} A to keep properties (a)-(c); then with A = Lambda[x]/J and NL presented by J/J^2 -> Ax, re-chooses generators so the image of H^{-1}(xi (L) k) misses one basis vector f_m, and sets A' = Lambda[x]/(f_1,...,f_{m-1}, p f_m) with p a uniformizer; (a) holds by construction, (b) since d f_m maps to zero, and (c) since E -> NL_{A/A'} = I[1] is zero on H^{-1} by the Ext computation.
